name: Toki Pona
creator: Sonja Lang
desc: Made specifically to be the smallest speakable language, Toki Pona is known to only have 120-140 distinct words.

name: Esperanto
creator: L. L. Zamenhof
desc: Created to be an international auxiliary (i.e. language people learn to communicate internationally) but it gets most of its vocabulary from Germanic & Romance languages.

name: Ithkuil
creator: John Quijada
desc: More of a thought experience than a language, it tries to be as dense as possible in how much meaning words have. Since every letter of a word encodes multiple pieces of meaning, entire sentences become single words.

name: Klingon
creator: Marc Okrand, James Doohan, Jon Povill
desc: Created for Star Trek to be spoken by the Klingon alien race.

name: Sindarin
creator: J.R.R. Tolkien
desc: One of the many conlangs made for The Lord of the Rings, spoken by the Grey Elves.

name: Quenya
creator: J.R.R. Tolkien
desc: One of the many conlangs made for The Lord of the Rings, spoken by the Elves in Middle-Earth.

name: Ar̃ojun
creator: Agma Schwa (youtube)
desc: A few friends created a world of their own back in 2007, leading on to the creation of not only Ar̃ojun, but an entire book written in the language.

name: Loglan
creator: James Cooke Brown
desc: Entirely made based on a thought experiment on how language affects thought.

name: Lojban
creator: Logical Language Group
desc: Created based on Loglan as a contiuation of Brown's work. There were many disputes and even a legal battle that led to how Lojban is today.

name: Anglish
creator: Paul Jennings
desc: Made as an offshoot of English that uses only words of Germanish root.

name: Vokhá'ábzhá
creator: Rai Carbin
desc: Ok I'll be honest I just wanted to throw in my current project for fun.
